sloka: राज्येन नास्ति मे कार्यं किं करिष्यामि सीतया।कुम्भकर्णविहीनस्य जीविते नास्ति मे रतिः ।। ६.६८.१७ ।।
transliteration: rājyena nāsti me kāryaṁ kiṁ kariṣyāmi sītayā।kumbhakarṇavihīnasya jīvite nāsti me ratiḥ ।। 6.68.17 ।।

translations.english: "I have no purpose with the kingdom. What will I do with Sita? I have lost my life and mind with Kumbhakarna's death."
